long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Perth, Aaron Fidler studied computer electronics before working his way from vessel crew to chief engineer. In 2005, he used his savings and manufacturing study to pursue a gap in shore-power products. He co-founded Furrion, which expanded from marine electrical equipment into appliances, audiovisual systems and power-management products for recreational vehicles and other mobile markets.

Fidler moved from chief executive to chairman in 2021 and sold his Furrion shares when Lippert acquired the company later that year. He then moved to Dubai and resumed hands-on marine work, leading a refit and charter programme while testing ideas for lower-emission marine technology. His career combines practical engineering, product development and company-building across marine and mobile markets.

Born in Perth, Aaron Fidler studied computer electronics before working his way from vessel crew to chief engineer. Fidler moved from chief executive to chairman in 2021 and sold his Furrion shares when Lippert acquired the company later that year. He then moved to Dubai and resumed hands-on marine work, leading a refit and charter programme while testing ideas for lower-emission marine technology. His career combines practical engineering, product development and company-building across marine and mobile markets.
